page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with four marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top, page number 6 at the top left of the text block. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: derivatus magno urbis commodo, au-ctúsque illic amnis Ahæ aquis è Drentiâ similiter venientibus, perque longum spatium infra urbem ejusdem Ahæ alveo vectus Vnderwerumium usque, atque ibi veteri alveo redditus, aggeribus ab urbe ad exitum utrimque compressus, toto hoc infrà urbem spatio ab arundinum copiâ voce Germanicâ Heitdiep Ahā amnis Hunefo iunctus.vulgò jam nuncupatur, veteri nomine illo Hunesi prorsus obliterato, & accolis etiam omnibus ignoto ac penè inaudito. Quæ verò pars ejus est supra urbem, per Drentiam & Præfecturam suburbanam meâns[?], hodiè à navium certâ specie, quarum in eâ usus est frequens comportandis ad urbem cespitibus, id est, glebis palustribus in usum ignis, vocatur Schutendiep Heitdiep./ habetque utrinque agros humiles & uliginosos, per quos decurrit, & præterquam, quâ aggeribus constricta est, eosdem sæpe inundat. At alter amnis è duobus, quos dixi hunc agrum olim se-cuisse, nomen Fivelâ habuit, jam prorsus etiam ignotum, & è Duerswoldijs finitimis Præfecturæ veteri, aut ex ipsâ Præ-

page.notes: Left margin notes, in order: "Aha amnis Hunefo iunctus." (beside the first line); "Heitdiep." (beside the copiâ line, printed as "Keit-diep" in black letter, first letter doubtful); "Schutendiep." (beside the "in usum ignis" line, the margin word is printed as "Schu-tendiep"); "Fivela flu." (beside the "jam prorsus" line, printed in italic). The page is a single text column with no heading. The word "meâns" in the text is doubtful, as is "Heitdiep" in the margin note and in the text. The black letter in the text and notes was read by eye and may be off.
